title: stenochlaena cochinchinensis

It is traditionally used in Southeast Asian folk medicine to treat various health conditions. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of fever, rheumatism, and skin infections.
